import pandas as pd
from itertools import product
def prepare(name, fgrid, ofgrid):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in fgrid for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(fgrid),len(fgrid[0])
    r0=min(r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for c in range(W)) for g in [fgrid]); 
    # compute bbox properly
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if fgrid[r][c]!=bg]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    rows=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if fgrid[r][c]!=bg: continue
            L=[x for x in range(W) if fgrid[r][x]!=bg and x<c]; R=[x for x in range(W) if fgrid[r][x]!=bg and x>c]
            U=[y for y in range(H) if fgrid[y][c]!=bg and y<r]; D=[y for y in range(H) if fgrid[y][c]!=bg and y>r]
            hgap=(len(L)>=1 and len(R)>=1)
            vgap=(len(U)>=1 and len(D)>=1)
            distL=c-max(0,min(L)) if L else 99
            distR=min(R)-c if R else 99
            inbgr=(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)
            onborder=(r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1))
            rows.append([name,r,c,ofgrid[r][c]==2,hgap,vgap,distL,distR,inbgr,onborder])
    return rows
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    df=pd.DataFrame(prepare(name,G[name+' input'],G[name+' output']),
                    columns=['name','r','c','filled','hgap','vgap','dL','dR','inbbox','border'])
    print(name,'samples:')
    for row in df[df['filled']][:6].values: print(row.tolist())
    print(name,'nonfills samples:',df[~df['filled']].head(6).values.tolist())

import itertools
def build(i):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in i for x in row)
    bgv=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    shp=[c for c,_ in cnt.items() if c!=bgv and c!=2]
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if i[r][c] in shp]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pts); r1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
